en: Hand‑tinted landscape view of a sandy, grassy beach beside a calm body of water, likely a lake or sheltered sea bay. In the distance are low wooden buildings among trees on the opposite shore, with dense coniferous forest stretching to the right. Several small human figures walk or stand along the waterline. The overall colorization and composition suggest an early 20th‑century tourist or landscape postcard.
